prompt: How many countries were part of the commonwealth on the date Prince Charles ascended?
answer:
On **8 September 2022**, when Prince Charles became King Charles III, the **Commonwealth of Nations had 56 member countries**.  

Of those, **15 were Commonwealth realms**—the United Kingdom plus 14 other countries where Charles was head of state.
